ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with an approximate 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels. High-intensity pixels are predominantly located at the distal lobe tips, while low-intensity pixels cover the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones are localized on the distal tips of both lobes. The left tip contains a broad white region with internal low-intensity mottling and punctate spots. The right tip is predominantly white with irregular low-intensity bordering at the edge. The central region consists of a continuous low-intensity black field containing sparse, high-contrast white dots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 75-80 degrees. The depression depth is approximately 1/6th of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits high-frequency serration. The left lobe contains at least four major indentations (macro-valleys) interspersed with fine-scale irregular peaks. The right lobe shows a similar jagged profile, terminating in a distinct, irregular protrusion at the lateral edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge trajectory follows a concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips. The overall geometric sweep of the lobes is symmetrical and extends upward and outward from the central peduncle attachment point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters are distributed across the dark central field. A dense, dark-textured cluster of high-contrast anomalies (sessile organisms) is visible at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of unaligned, light-colored linear pixel disruptions. Multiple horizontal and diagonal rake marks are visible across the lower-middle section of the right lobe and the upper-middle section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring in the form of linear rake marks across the central dark pigment. The distal tips exhibit irregular, jagged edges consistent with previous tissue loss or environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark, textured cluster (likely barnacles) concentrated on the rightmost edge of the fluke. A small, high-intensity punctate spot is visible on the far upper-left leading edge.
